tenures.source: The fed's own news archive, which introduces the group unnamed in mid-February 2002 and reveals Petapaw as its own head at the fed's own February PPV (promotions/chz/archive/news-archive-2002.html); Wild Dog billed "from the NBK" and Knyghtmare billed "representing the Natural Born KillaZ" on the 22 March 2002 broadcast (promotions/chz/archive/wnw-2002-03-22.html); billed the NBK Pride main event opposite Matt Helms and Chazzy 2 Cool (promotions/chz/archive/nbk-pride-card.html). /promotions/chz/archive/wnw-2003-03-05.html; /promotions/chz/archive/wnw-2003-03-26.html; /promotions/chz/archive/wnw-2003-04-02.html; /promotions/chz/archive/wnw-2003-04-09.html; /promotions/chz/archive/wnw-2003-04-23.html; /promotions/chz/archive/wnw-2003-04-30.html; /promotions/chz/archive/may-hayday-2-2003-05-14.html; /promotions/chz/archive/wnw-2003-05-21.html

In 2003 the stable, written nBk, takes in Mad Max, Xstacy, Harry Manback, Rage, the Reaper, Archangel, the Darkness and Chris CK, and works with the ACC against Matt Helms.

caption: Lucifer's own dark-themed stable, named in the news archive with Don Rossi (rumored to be splitting off to form his own group) and Fire as members alongside a retiring Diablo; Fire was released from contract by early March 2002 and Rossi appears estranged from the group by the 22 March 2002 broadcast, feuding directly with Diablo.

tenures.source: Named by Lucifer on the 23 January 2002 Wednesday Night Wild: "This man right here, that Monster! Diablo! That beast Fire right there and myself we are the Disciples of Darkness" (promotions/chz/archive/wnw-2002-01-23.html). The fed's own news archive, "Rossi's Stable" item, 15 February 2002 (promotions/chz/archive/news-archive-2002.html): "CHZ North American Champion, Don 'The Game' Rossi, is going to jump ship from DOD and form his own Stable. Already confirmed as being part of his team is, another DOD member, and his long time friend Fire... DOD last week received very upsetting news with Diablo retiring."
tenures.note: Lucifer names himself, Diablo and Fire the Disciples of Darkness on 23 January 2002, the night Fire turns on Matt Helms. "Fire" is released from contract per the news archive's own 10 March 2002 roster update.

tenures.source: The 20 February 2002 Wednesday Night Wild (/promotions/chz/archive/wnw-2002-02-20.html) and the 27 February 2002 No Luv (/promotions/chz/archive/no-luv-2002-02-27.html); The fed's own news archive, "Stable War?" item, 22 February 2002: "the reformation of the OUTLAWZ on Wednesday Night Wild" (promotions/chz/archive/news-archive-2002.html); the Hall of Fame's own Jaguar-F entry, crediting him with heading "the Outlawz Revolution" (promotions/chz/archive/hall-of-fame.html); Rage discards a t-shirt bearing the Outlawz logo on his former ally Don Rossi while attacking him for the NBK, 22 March 2002 (promotions/chz/archive/wnw-2002-03-22.html).
tenures.note: The 20 February 2002 Wild forms the group from The Count, Staz, Rage and Don Rossi, and No Luv names the same four; on 22 March 2002 Rage throws an Outlawz shirt on Rossi while attacking him, which may mark either man's departure from the group.

Its aka DOT (the fed's own abbreviation, 9 and 23 January 2002) is the name of dot-aowf, a manager in another fed; no receipt in the CHZ record connects this tag team to that character. Filed distinct per the no-auto-merge collision doctrine.
